\section*{Commentary}
Augustine, \work{Enarrationes in Psalmos} 8, is read at the Introit.

\section*{The Propers: Interpretive Possibilities}
Everything below is exploratory editorial and AI proposal.

\begin{proposal}{The Introit's address and the Collect's petition}
\pfield{Anchors}{The Introit and the Collect.}
\pfield{Mechanism}{One address, made twice in two grammatical registers.}
